propositions: The .bridge_state cache in bindings.json (18 MB) occupies 92% of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch despite events being only 55 MB, driven by high-churn metadata fields baseline_advanced_at (1144 changes per pass) and last_get_pass (20 changes per pass) that defeat git delta compression.

Current marginal packed cost per bindings.json version is 12.79 KB, and removing baseline_advanced_at reduces this to 1.74 KB (7.4x improvement); moving last_get_pass to a sidecar and deleting the inline field halves the version count (12.8x total improvement).

The reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub runners, requiring durable state in git; the cache must remain committed on-branch and made cheap by eliminating unnecessary timestamp writes and normalizing baseline text fields rather than re-homing the cache.

A proven git fast-export/filter/fast-import pipeline reduces the branch from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4% final size) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges and restoring HEAD tree byte-identity.

Multi-stage rollout with write-format transitions (baseline_advanced_at deletion, last_get_pass sidecar migration, corpus narrowing) requires mixed-version read compatibility, direct workflow/deployment epoch evidence, and a quiesced publication window with operator attestation.

Rollback is an explicit manual window requiring bundle verification, ref restoration, and writer re-cloning to detect stale-epoch clones via fail-closed checks at union and push sites, with no application-level merge-guard bypass.
